description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of epochs and the Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning methods of the Whisper model, specifically for the 'tiny' type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents the WER, also with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different fine-tuning method: tiny AdaLoRA_int4 (dark gray, circle markers, solid line), tiny AdaLoRA_int8 (gray, square markers, solid line), tiny int4 (dark gray, circle markers, dashed line), tiny int8 (gray, square markers, dashed line), and tiny full (light gray, triangle markers, dotted line). The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line starts at approximately 68 at epoch 0 and decreases to around 37 at epoch 6. The tiny AdaLoRA_int8 line begins at about 59 at epoch 0 and ends at roughly 34 at epoch 6. The tiny int4 line starts at approximately 69 at epoch 0 and decreases to around 36 at epoch 6. The tiny int8 line begins at about 54 at epoch 0 and ends at roughly 35 at epoch 6. The tiny full line remains relatively stable, starting at around 29 at epoch 0 and ending at approximately 26 at epoch 6. All lines except tiny full exhibit a declining trend across the epochs.
